semantics: Nodes assert propositions, not tasks. Premise edges support conditional conclusions; target_definition edges identify a mathematical space without assuming the source conjecture true. No cross-branch implication is silently assumed.

conjectures.label: C1

result.proof: Exact invertible full threshold block and explicit Neumann bound; see RIM-THRESHOLD.md.

conjectures.statement: The fixed two-rim fixture has no bounded non-L2 threshold solution with nonzero lead component. Its flux-normalized transmission and reflection matrices obey T(k)=O(k), R(k)=-I2+O(k) as k decreases to zero.
conjectures.quantifiers: There exist C>0 and k0>0 such that ||T(k)||<=C k and ||R(k)+I2||<=C k for every 0<k<k0.
conjectures.threshold_test: At theta=1/2, the full block [[-2I2,2W*],[2W,theta I24-K-2WW*]] has no kernel vector (u,chi) with u!=0. Pure dark/core solutions do not count as lead threshold resonances.
conjectures.falsifier: A threshold solution with u!=0, or failure of either uniform O(k) bound at this fixture.

conjectures.label: C2

result.argument: The same-space reference differs by a rank-six trace-class coupling; Kato-Rosenblum gives full-space wave operators and ac completeness. C9 removes singular-continuous spectrum. Fresh full-core inertia brackets certify exactly five simple above-band modes; positivity and K-only cyclicity exclude other point spectrum.

conjectures.next_action: Resolved for the fixed three-port Hilbert space. C5 and C7 are now ready for their separate bound-retention and channel-rank reviews; do not promote them solely from this dependency update.
conjectures.statement: For the fixed eleven-state-plus-leads Hamiltonian, the pure-point subspace consists exactly of the five reported above-band modes, the singular-continuous subspace is zero, and outgoing wave operators from the three free chains are complete. Every initially central state is the sum of its persistent bound part and an asymptotically free outgoing lead packet.
conjectures.quantifiers: On the full free three-lead Hilbert space, W_+=s-lim_(t->+infinity) exp(itH) J exp(-itH_D) exists, W_+*W_+=I, and Ran(W_+)=H_ac(H). P_pp(H) is the full-tail-normalized projection P_b onto exactly the five reported modes, and P_sc(H)=0. Consequently every initially central psi has the asymptote phi_out=W_+*(I-P_b)psi with ||exp(-itH)(I-P_b)psi-J exp(-itH_D)phi_out|| -> 0.
conjectures.scope: Full-space scattering decomposition, not reconstruction of arbitrary finite interaction histories from asymptotic amplitudes.
conjectures.falsifier: Another L2 eigenmode, a singular-continuous component, or a central state whose orthogonal-to-bound component has no such outgoing asymptote.

conjectures.label: C3
conjectures.statement: There exists a rank-four complex J:C2 tensor C2 -> C10 with KJ=J(T_gamma tensor T_gamma), J*J=G_gamma tensor G_gamma, and [K,P]=0 for P=J(G_gamma tensor G_gamma)^(-1)J*. The complementary six coordinates are retained. This asserts an abstract reducing tensor carrier only; source-generated independent factor controls and physical output identification are not asserted.
conjectures.quantifiers: Existence of J satisfying the displayed polynomial identities; independence means the full tensor product, not two overlapping path drawings or a direct sum relabelled as two particles.
conjectures.falsifier: An exact obstruction to the rank-four intertwiner, even before the metric and complement conditions.

result.reason: U³=I4 but det(K³-I10)=-64, so KJ=JU forces J=0.

conjectures.label: C4

result.proof: C1 is discharged; integrate its uniform squared transmission bound over the normalized incoming packet.

conjectures.statement: If C1 holds, every normalized incoming asymptotic packet supported in 1/2<E<1/2+epsilon has total opposite-side transmission at most C_packet epsilon, uniformly over its two-port profile and phase.
conjectures.quantifiers: There exist C_packet,epsilon0>0 such that integral ||T(E)f(E)||² dE <= C_packet epsilon for all 0<epsilon<epsilon0 and all f with integral ||f(E)||² dE=1 and the stated support.
conjectures.falsifier: Under C1, a sequence of such packets with transmission/epsilon unbounded.
conjectures.argument: k²=E-1/2; bound the normalized spectral integral by sup ||T||². This is an asymptotic packet statement, not capture of a locally prepared bound state.

conjectures.label: C5

result.argument: C2 gives fixed-region local decay of the ac part; distinct bound frequencies diagonalize the time average before R tends to infinity. Fresh exact sector/cofactor checks certify nonzero overlaps with 2/2/3/5/5 bound modes for the five named preparations.

conjectures.statement: If C2 holds, each named normalized central preparation in the bound-spectrum report retains exactly ||P_b psi||²>0 in the large-region, long-time-averaged sense; its escaping squared norm is 1-||P_b psi||², not one.
conjectures.quantifiers: lim_(R->infinity) lim_(T->infinity) (1/T) integral_0^T ||P_R exp(-itH)psi||² dt = ||P_b psi||², where P_R keeps the central eleven coordinates and the first R sites of each lead. Positivity uses the reported nonzero-overlap certificates for the named preparations.
conjectures.falsifier: Violation of the ordered-limit identity under C2, or a zero bound overlap for one of the named preparations.
conjectures.argument: Use outgoing free-packet local decay and retained bound tails; instantaneous central occupation need not converge because bound modes beat.

conjectures.label: C6

result.argument: For every shared isometry V and phase alpha, the limiting operator defect is at least sqrt(2). C1/C11 make the finite-k correction tend to zero, excluding the asserted intertwiner independently of C2.

conjectures.next_action: Resolved in the shared incoming/outgoing isometry class. Independent input/output maps or larger retained comparison packages require a different proposition.
conjectures.statement: Under C1 and the source-bound three-port threshold statement C11, no regular flux-isometric family V(k):C3 -> C4 intertwines the full three-port scattering matrix with the two-rim matrix near their respective lower thresholds, even up to a common phase.
conjectures.quantifiers: There do not exist V(k),alpha(k) with V*V=I3, |alpha|=1, isometric/unit-modulus limits at k=0, and S_rim(1/2+k²)V(k)=alpha(k)V(k)S_port(2-2cos(k)) for all sufficiently small k>0. S_port is metric-whitened; coefficient-versus-endpoint common phases are absorbed in alpha.
conjectures.falsifier: Such a family under the stated assumptions; not a projection that drops a port or a singular, differently prepared comparison.
conjectures.scope: One shared isometric identification V for both incoming and outgoing fibers, up to a scalar phase. The proof covers the stated regular families and also rules out escape by nonconvergence of V/alpha alone. Separate input/output frame maps, added channels and non-isometric changes are outside this obstruction.
conjectures.argument: C1 gives S_rim(0+)=-I4. The reported three-port limit is a Householder matrix with eigenvalues (-1,1,1). Left multiplication by V0* would require this nonscalar matrix to be a scalar multiple of I3.

conjectures.model: three_port and the target space of glued_one_step

result.argument: C2 identifies the a.e. outgoing energy fiber as C3. The target metric diag(9,3,3,1) is positive and has rank four, while F*F for F:C4->C3 has rank at most three.

conjectures.next_action: Resolved for the full target at fixed energy in the single-excitation fiber. Energy mixing, extra channels and multi-excitation sectors are different propositions.
conjectures.statement: Under C2, the full four-dimensional two-factor target specified in C3 cannot be isometrically embedded at fixed total energy in the three-port model's single-excitation outgoing channel fiber.
conjectures.quantifiers: For almost every E in (0,4), no F(E):C2 tensor C2 -> C3 satisfies F(E)*F(E)=G_gamma tensor G_gamma. A change to multi-excitation/Fock sectors or extra channels changes the model.
conjectures.falsifier: A rank-four isometry into that three-dimensional fiber without changing the sector, energy-fiber meaning or channel count.
conjectures.argument: C2 identifies the outgoing fiber as C3, while the positive target metric has rank four. rank(F*F)<=3. This uses C3's target definition, not its refuted existence assertion.

conjectures.label: C9
conjectures.model: three_port; the fixed coupled eleven-state plus three weighted half-line chains

result.argument: Finite-support resolvent entries are rational in the half-line Weyl function. The core Schur determinant is a nonzero polynomial with constant term 1, leaving finitely many exceptional energies including both thresholds. Measures are absolutely continuous elsewhere and only atomic on that finite set; density gives P_sc(H)=0.

conjectures.statement: The spectral projection onto the singular-continuous subspace of the fixed three-port Hamiltonian is zero, including at both band edges.
conjectures.quantifiers: For every psi in the full coupled Hilbert space, its spectral measure has only absolutely continuous and pure-point parts on R: P_sc(H)psi=0.
conjectures.falsifier: A vector with nonzero singular-continuous spectral measure for this fixed H.
conjectures.next_action: Resolved by the rational-Weyl spectral-measure proof. C2 is now ready for its separate full-space wave-operator and point-spectrum assembly; neither follows merely from the C9 disposition.

conjectures.quantifiers: There exist linear contractions R_n:H_n->C12 for all n>=0, with R_0=I12 and R_(n+1) A_n=D R_n, where A_n|h>=sum_(b:D[b,last(h)]=1)|h,b>/sqrt(d_last(h)). The allowed histories, metrics and clock are fixed, not optimization variables.

conjectures.next_action: Resolved by the exact depth-zero norm obstruction. Replay check_raw_macro_readout.py --check after source changes; do not infer failure of richer retained comparison packages or C8's separate carrier test.
conjectures.scope: Norm-constrained raw-amplitude readout diagnostic, NOT the criterion for witnessed constructive identity. It tests reproduction of unweighted D, not generation and reuse of a joint comparison certificate. Failure does not exclude a richer retained constructor, weighted/heralded model or independently specified verification stage. Source authorization and physical counting metric remain unestablished.

conjectures.model: three_port, with the coefficient scattering convention and metric whitening of native-port-scattering.md

result.argument: Fresh exact core rank 10, positive visible zero-mode norm and K-only cyclic dimension 11. The imaginary-part/cyclicity argument excludes all interior real poles; the simple-kernel Schur expansion yields the coefficient Householder limit.

conjectures.statement: The fixed core has a simple zero mode with nonzero port projection, the open-band response has no real pole, and its lower-threshold scattering limit is the metric-whitened Householder reflection I3-2ww* with eigenvalues (-1,1,1).
conjectures.quantifiers: For all 0<k<pi the outgoing response exists, and lim_(k->0+) H_port^(1/2) S(2-2cos(k)) H_port^(-1/2)=I3-2ww*, where w is the normalized whitened visible projection of the unique core zero mode.

conjectures.next_action: Resolved by fresh exact finite certificates and the analytic threshold expansion. C6 is now ready for its separate shared-frame comparison proof; no completeness or physical outcome is promoted.
